title: Generating Equivalent Fractions
objective: Generate simple equivalent fractions by using visual fraction models and the number line.

problems.text: Write the shaded fraction of each figure on the blank. Then, draw a line to match the equivalent fractions.
Write the missing parts of the fractions.
Why does it take 2 copies of 1/8 to show the same amount as 1 copy of 1/4? Explain your answer in words and pictures.
How many sixths does it take to make the same amount as 1/3? Explain your answer in words and pictures.
